profile.name: Finance Controller
profile.description: Keeps your numbers true: checks every day that sales, payments, refunds and tax line up, watches payment approval, fees and the fraud review queue, forecasts subscription revenue, and has a clean close package ready early each month.

listing.pitch: Your controller: makes sure the money matches, catches leaks early, and has month-end ready before you ask.
highlights: Checks every day that sales, payments and refunds agree
Tracks refund rate, payment approval and processing fees by account and country
Forecasts the next 30 days of subscription renewals and the revenue at risk
Works the fraud review queue with a recommendation for every held order
Watches tax collected and filings that need attention
Builds the month-end close package, with every number traced to its source
example_prompts: Do yesterday's orders match the payments we captured?
What did refunds cost us this month, and what's driving them?
Which orders are waiting on a fraud review, and what do you recommend?
How much subscription revenue renews in the next 30 days, and how much is at risk?
What are we paying in processing fees, by payment account?
Is the October close package ready?

suggested_triggers.label: Every Monday at 9am: weekly finance review
2nd of the month at 8am: close package
When a subscription payment is declined
